parameters.name: Force
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcibly delete the share if data synchronization is not complete for the share. Valid values:

*   true: forcibly deletes the share. Proceed with caution.
*   false: does not forcibly delete the share. This is the default value.

parameters.name: IndexId
parameters.description: The ID of the share. You can call the DescribeGatewayFileShares operation to query the share ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw delete-gateway-file-shares --gateway-id gw-000eg44nmxbsfwbv0000 --index-id NFSalex000 --biz-force false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sgw DeleteGatewayFileShares --region cn-hangzhou --IndexId NFSalex000 --Force false --GatewayId 'gw-000eg44nmxbsfwbv0000'
